Trains Stopped for Navratri Pilgrimage to Vindhyachal

During the Navratri festival, 12 trains will have a temporary halt until October 26 to facilitate pilgrims traveling to Vindhyachal. Additionally, 200 special buses will operate on ten routes from Prayagraj to Vindhyachal and other locations, with services available every 15 minutes.
